title: Suggestion for more open electives in sixth semester
description: Only two open electives are offered to our branch in the sixth semester. I would like to suggest adding a few more options like data analytics or entrepreneurship so that students have a real choice.

title: Please add more elective choices
description: The elective list for third year has just two subjects and both are theory heavy. It would be good if the department can introduce some more electives from next year.

title: Limited elective subjects offered
description: Sir, this is a suggestion. Other colleges under the same university offer five or six electives, here we get only two. Kindly consider widening the elective basket.

title: Query about revaluation procedure
description: I want to know the procedure for applying for revaluation of a theory paper. Where is the form available and what is the usual time for the result?

title: How to apply for rechecking of answer script
description: This is a general query. I am not satisfied with my marks in one subject and would like to know how rechecking works and whom to approach in the exam cell.

title: Information needed on photocopy of answer sheet
description: Can the exam section please tell me the steps to get a photocopy of my answer sheet and apply for revaluation? I could not find the details on the website.

title: Request to upload lecture slides on the portal
description: Many faculty members show slides in class but do not share them. I request that the PPTs be uploaded on the student portal so we can revise properly.

title: Lecture notes not shared after class
description: It would help a lot if teachers upload their presentation files and notes to the LMS after each unit. Right now we have to click photos of the projector screen.

title: Sharing of class PPTs
description: Please ask teachers to share the unit wise slides in the class group.

title: Suggestion to arrange industry guest lectures
description: We hardly get any exposure to what is happening in industry. I suggest the department arrange one guest lecture every month by an alumni or a working professional.

title: Guest talks by alumni
description: This is just an idea for the department. Alumni working in good companies can be invited for talks on weekends so that students understand what skills are expected.

title: Request for expert sessions
description: Kindly consider organising expert sessions on new topics like cloud and machine learning. Such sessions were held two years ago and seniors say they were very helpful.

title: Request for doubt clearing session before end semester exam
description: A few of us have doubts in the last two units of mathematics. Could an extra doubt clearing class be arranged some time before the end semester exams?

title: Extra class for doubts
description: Requesting the maths faculty to take one additional session for solving doubts. Any free slot in the coming weeks is fine for the class.

title: Need a revision class for difficult units
description: Students of section B would like a revision lecture on the numerical portions of the subject. This is a request, there is no hurry, any convenient date will do.

title: Long gap between lectures in timetable
description: On Wednesdays we have a class at 9 am and the next one directly at 2 pm. I suggest the timetable be adjusted a little so the free hours in between are reduced.

title: Timetable suggestion for second year
description: Four hour break on two days. Can the slots be rearranged?

title: Minor change requested in class schedule
description: It is a small thing, but the afternoon lecture on Friday could be shifted to the morning free slot. That way students travelling home for the weekend can leave earlier.

title: Query regarding honours degree registration
description: I heard that students with good CGPA can register for an honours or minor degree. Please let me know the eligibility and when the registration opens.

title: Details about minor specialisation
description: Can someone from the academic section explain how the minor degree works, how many extra credits are needed and whether classes are held in the evening?

title: Clarification on minor course credits
description: General enquiry: I am interested in taking a minor in management along with my engineering degree. Where can I read the rules for this?

title: Previous year question papers not available
description: The library has question papers only up to 2021. I request the department to share the more recent papers so that we get an idea of the pattern.

title: Request for old question papers
description: Could the exam cell upload the last three years of university question papers on the website? It would save students from hunting for them in senior batches.

title: Model question papers needed
description: It will be helpful if each subject teacher can give one model paper or the earlier question papers before the exams. Just a request from the class.

title: Suggestion to include aptitude training in timetable
description: Placement season starts next year for us. I suggest one hour per week be kept for aptitude and reasoning practice in the regular timetable.

title: Start a coding practice hour
description: My suggestion is to have a weekly coding practice slot in the computer lab with a faculty mentor. Many students do not practise on their own.

title: Idea for soft skills classes
description: Students from regional medium schools struggle in interviews. A communication skills class once a week would be a nice addition to the curriculum.

title: Internal marks not updated on portal
description: The second internal test was conducted three weeks back but the marks are still not showing on the student portal. I have asked the class coordinator twice.

title: Mid term marks missing for two subjects
description: Mid term marks of two subjects still not entered after 15 days.

title: Sessional marks pending since weeks
description: Marks of the first sessional are visible for all subjects except DBMS. The faculty says it is uploaded, the portal shows blank. This is pending for almost a month.

title: Syllabus not being completed in physics
description: Our physics lectures have been cancelled repeatedly this month. Sometimes we are told ten minutes before the class, sometimes nobody comes at all. Only two units out of five are done and the exams are a few weeks away. We informed the HOD once already and were told it would be looked into.

title: Classes frequently cancelled by faculty
description: The faculty for compiler design has taken only six classes in the last five weeks. Most days the class is cancelled at the last minute and the portion is lagging badly.

title: Portion left incomplete
description: More than half the syllabus of engineering drawing is pending because the teacher was on leave for many days and no substitute was given. Students are worried about covering it.

title: Attendance wrongly marked absent
description: I was present for all lectures in the week of 4th to 8th but the portal shows me absent for four of them. I gave a written request a week ago and nothing has changed.

title: Attendance not corrected after request
description: My attendance in the microprocessor lab is marked absent for three sessions which I attended and even got my journal signed. The correction request is pending for ten days.

title: Wrong attendance entry in ERP
description: The ERP shows 62 percent attendance for me in one subject whereas my own count is above 80. I have complained to the subject teacher two times, the entry is the same.

title: Revaluation result pending for over a month
description: I applied for revaluation of one paper and paid for it in the first week of last month. Results of other students have come but mine is still awaited.

title: No update on rechecking application
description: It is now six weeks since I submitted the rechecking form for engineering mechanics. The exam cell keeps saying it will come next week.

title: Revaluation delay

title: Lab sessions not conducted for three weeks

title: Practicals not being held

title: Practical classes skipped repeatedly

title: Marks wrongly totalled in mid sem

title: Counting error in evaluated paper

title: Project guide not available for meetings

title: No guidance from project supervisor

title: Mini project guide not responding
description: Repeated requests to our mini project mentor for a discussion slot have got no reply for three weeks. Other groups have already finished their design phase.

title: Result withheld for one subject

title: Result not declared
description: Whole class got the result, mine shows RL for ten days. No dues pending.

title: Transcript not issued even after two weeks

title: Delay in getting course completion letter
description: The department was supposed to issue my course completion letter within three working days. It has been more than ten days and the file is still on someone's table.

title: Assignment marks not given fairly
description: In all three assignments of the subject I have been given 4 out of 10 although I submitted on time and the content is the same as what others wrote. I raised this earlier too.

title: Evaluation of assignments is inconsistent
description: Two students with identical answers got very different marks in the tutorial sheets. This has happened repeatedly this semester and the teacher refuses to recheck.

title: Low marks in term work without reason

title: No faculty for subject since three weeks

title: Subject teacher changed thrice
description: In this semester the faculty for signals and systems has been changed three times. Each one starts again from unit one and the syllabus is not moving forward.

title: Subject left without a teacher
description: After our maths teacher went on long leave, there has been no replacement for almost a month. The class representative has reported it to the department more than once.

title: Wrong elective allotted
description: I had chosen machine learning as my elective but the portal shows embedded systems. My change request has been pending with the department for two weeks.

title: Elective change request not processed
description: Due to some error I am registered in an elective I never opted for. Classes have started and I am missing the lectures of my actual choice since ten days.

title: Elective allotment error
description: The elective allotment list has my name under a different subject from the one in my submitted form. I have given a written application, there is no response for many days.

title: Backlog exam form not accepted on portal

title: Unable to register for arrear subject

title: Supplementary exam registration issue

title: Internship approval letter pending
description: The company has asked for a recommendation letter from college for my internship. The training cell is sitting on the request for the past two weeks.

title: Name spelt wrongly on marksheet

title: Correction in marksheet pending
description: My father's name is printed wrongly on the grade card. The office took my application and documents one month ago, since then there is no progress.

title: Wrong absent entry in university result

description: My condonation application for attendance shortage is not yet signed by the HOD. The last date for exam form submission is today and without approval I cannot appear this semester.

description: The online submission link for the term assignment closes today at 5 pm and it shows server error since morning. This assignment carries 20 marks of internal assessment.

title: Report upload failing on last day
description: Today is the last date to submit the internship report on the LMS and the file upload fails each time. The teacher has said late submissions will not be evaluated.

title: Transcript needed for university application due tomorrow

title: Provisional certificate required by tomorrow

title: Roll number missing from seating plan

title: Internal marks locking tomorrow without my re-exam
description: I had an accident on the day of the sessional test and produced the medical papers. No re-exam has been given and the department says marks get frozen tomorrow.

title: Missed test due to surgery, no second chance given
description: Because of a surgery I could not write one class test. The final internal marks are being sent to the university today and I am being given zero for that test.

title: No backlog certificate needed for placement drive tomorrow
description: A company is visiting campus tomorrow and requires a certificate that I have no active backlogs. The exam section has not issued it though I applied last week. I will miss the drive.

title: Consolidated marksheet not given before interview
description: I have a final round interview tomorrow morning where the consolidated marksheet is compulsory. The office staff says it will take three more days.

description: The placement portal picks CGPA from the ERP, which shows mine as 6.1 instead of 7.4. Registration for the drive closes today night and I am becoming ineligible because of this error.

title: Suggestion to extend mess dinner timing

description: A small request to the mess committee: please serve dinner up to 9 pm at least on weekdays, since sports practice ends late.

title: Request for more variety in mess menu
description: The same sabzi and dal are repeated most days of the week. I request the mess committee to add some variety and maybe a South Indian breakfast once a week.

description: Worms were found in the rice served tonight and a number of students who had already eaten are having stomach pain and fever.

title: Outsider entered girls hostel at night
description: An unknown man was seen on the second floor of the girls hostel around 1 am last night. The guard was not at the gate. We are scared to stay here.

title: Stranger found inside hostel premises
description: Late last night a stranger climbed over the back wall and was roaming near our rooms. There is no security guard on that side. Girls are feeling unsafe.

title: Security lapse, unknown person in hostel
description: Two outsiders walked into the boys hostel today afternoon without any entry at the gate and a laptop is missing from one room. Security needs to act at once.

title: Fire in hostel room due to short circuit
description: There was a short circuit in room 305 this evening and the curtain caught fire. We put it out with buckets. The wiring of the whole floor smells of burning.

title: Smoke coming from electrical panel
description: Smoke from the main electrical panel on the ground floor right now. No extinguisher nearby!

title: Burning smell and sparks from meter box
description: Since tonight the meter box outside our wing is giving sparks and a burning smell. A fire can start any time and students are sleeping in the rooms next to it.

title: Ceiling plaster fell on student
description: A big piece of ceiling plaster fell on my roommate's bed last night and he has a head injury. More cracks are visible and the rest may fall as well.

title: Roof of hostel room about to collapse
description: The roof slab in room 12 has developed deep cracks and chunks of cement are falling. One student was hurt on the shoulder today. We cannot stay in this room.

title: Balcony railing broke, student injured
description: The balcony railing on the third floor gave way this morning and a student nearly fell down. He has injuries on his arm. The other railings are also shaking.

title: Student seriously ill, no vehicle or warden at night
description: My roommate had severe chest pain at 2 am and there was no warden, no ambulance and no vehicle available. We had to carry him to the gate. This is a medical emergency failure.

title: No help during medical emergency in hostel
description: A girl in our wing had a seizure last night. The warden did not pick up the phone and the first aid box was empty. It took an hour to reach the hospital.

title: Hostel has no arrangement for sick students at night
description: Yesterday night a student with very high fever fainted in the corridor. The gate was locked and the guard refused to open it without the warden. The rules for urgent medical cases must change.

title: Snake found inside hostel room
description: A snake was found under the bed in a ground floor room tonight. The bushes behind the hostel are not cleared. Students on the ground floor are afraid to sleep.

title: Snake in hostel bathroom
description: Snake seen in block D bathroom this morning, it went into the drain. Call a snake catcher today.

title: Scorpion bite in hostel
description: A first year student was bitten by a scorpion in his room last night and was rushed to hospital. Insects and snakes are coming in from the open ground behind.

title: Theft in hostel rooms, locks broken
description: Three rooms on our floor were broken into today while we were in class. Laptops and cash are gone. The CCTV is not working and the guard saw nothing.

title: Laptop and phone stolen from locked room
description: My laptop and mobile were stolen last night from my room though it was locked from outside. This is the third theft this week and students feel unsafe.

title: Room lock broken and valuables missing
description: When I came back today my room lock was cut and my bag with certificates and money is missing. Please check the cameras and inform the police immediately.

title: Contaminated drinking water, students hospitalised
description: The drinking water in our hostel is muddy and smells of sewage since yesterday. Six students have been admitted with jaundice like symptoms. The tank must be cleaned today.

title: Dead lizard found in water tank
description: A dead lizard was found in the overhead drinking water tank this morning. Several students who drank the water are vomiting. Supply should be stopped now.

title: Sewage mixing with hostel water supply
description: Black coloured foul water is coming from the taps today and many students have diarrhoea. It looks like the sewage line has mixed with the water line.

title: Suggestion for benches in the campus garden
description: There are very few places to sit outside between lectures. I suggest putting some benches in the garden near the main building.

title: Seating area needed near academic block
description: Students stand around or sit on the steps during breaks. A few stone benches under the trees would be a good addition to the campus.

title: Request for outdoor seating
description: Kindly consider adding seating in the open area behind the canteen. It is just a suggestion to make the campus more comfortable.

title: Request for charging points in classrooms
description: Most classrooms have only one working socket near the teacher's table. Please add a few charging points along the walls as we use laptops in class.

title: More plug points needed in lecture halls
description: During long lecture days laptop batteries run out. It would be helpful to have extension boards or extra plug points in the lecture halls.

title: Charging sockets in library reading area
description: The reading area of the library has tables but no sockets nearby. Requesting a few power points so that students can work on laptops there.

title: Request for more cycle stands
description: The cycle stand near the main gate is always full. A second stand close to the mechanical block would be useful for day scholars.

title: Two wheeler parking suggestion
description: Parking for bikes is not marked and vehicles are parked randomly. I suggest painting parking lines and putting a shed over the area.

title: Covered parking for student vehicles
description: In summer the bike seats get extremely hot as there is no shade in the parking. Please consider a simple roof over the student parking.

title: Suggestion to extend library hours
description: The central library closes at 6 pm. I suggest keeping it open till 9 pm at least during exam months.

title: Library seating is limited
description: The reading hall of the library has seats for hardly sixty students. If possible, please add more tables and chairs in the empty area upstairs.

title: Request to open library on Sundays
description: Many day scholars would like to use the library on Sundays. Could it be opened for half a day on weekends?

title: No duster and markers in classroom
description: Room 204 never has a duster and the markers are dried up. Teachers have to borrow from the next class. Minor issue, please keep a set in the room.

title: Whiteboard is stained and hard to read
description: The whiteboard in our classroom has old marks that do not rub off, so writing is not clear from the back rows. It can be replaced or cleaned with a solution.

title: Chalk and duster not provided
description: The blackboard in the tutorial room is fine but there is no chalk box or duster kept there. A small request to the department office to supply them.

title: Wall clock not working in lecture hall
description: The clock in lecture hall 3 has been showing the wrong time. It only needs a battery change, please do it whenever possible.

title: Classroom clock stopped
description: Wall clock in room 112 has stopped. Please fix when possible.

title: Bell not audible in new block
description: The period bell cannot be heard in the new block classrooms. It would be good to put a small bell or speaker there.

title: Suggestion to plant trees near bus stop
description: The college bus stop has no shade and students wait in the sun. Planting a few trees or building a small shelter would be nice.

title: Shelter needed at the bus waiting area
description: A request to the estate office: please think of a tin shed at the place where students wait for the buses in the evening.

title: More greenery on campus
description: The ground between the two blocks is bare. I suggest a plantation drive by the NSS unit along with the garden department.

title: Request for new sports equipment
description: The sports room has only two footballs and the badminton rackets are old. Kindly buy some new equipment for the coming tournament season.

title: Gym equipment suggestion
description: The college gym has few dumbbells and one treadmill. Adding a couple of machines would encourage more students to use it.

title: Volleyball court needs a new net
description: Volleyball net is torn. Please arrange a new one.

title: Canteen seating suggestion
description: At lunch time the canteen gets so crowded that people eat standing. Some more tables and chairs can be added in the verandah.

title: Request for a juice counter in canteen
description: The canteen sells mostly fried snacks. Students would like a fresh juice or fruit counter. This is a suggestion for the canteen committee.

title: Canteen could have a token system
description: Suggesting a token or UPI based ordering in the canteen so that the queue at the counter moves faster during the short break.

title: Room numbers and sign boards missing
description: New students find it difficult to locate labs because many doors have no room number. Please put sign boards and a campus map near the entrance.

title: Direction boards on campus
description: There are no direction boards for the exam cell, library or accounts office. Simple arrow boards at junctions would help visitors and freshers.

title: Suggestion for campus map display
description: A large map of the campus at the main gate would be useful. Parents coming for admissions keep asking students for directions.

title: Request for sanitary pad vending machine
description: There is no sanitary napkin vending machine in the girls washroom of the academic block. Requesting the college to install one.

title: Mirror and hooks needed in washroom
description: The washrooms in the new building do not have mirrors or hooks for bags. Small fittings, kindly get them installed.

title: Hand wash dispensers in washrooms
description: Please provide soap dispensers near the wash basins in the department washrooms. At present there is nothing to wash hands with.

title: Query about booking the seminar hall
description: Our coding club wants to hold a workshop next month. How do we book the seminar hall and whose permission is needed?

title: How to reserve auditorium for an event
description: We are planning a cultural evening for the department. Please tell us the procedure and charges, if any, for using the auditorium.

title: Enquiry about using the computer lab after hours
description: Is it possible for a student group to use a computer lab from 5 to 7 pm for hackathon practice? Whom should we write to?

title: Projector not working in classroom
description: Room 301 projector dead for two weeks. Complaint not attended.

title: Classroom projector faulty for many days
description: The projector in our class shows a blurred yellow picture since the start of the month. We informed the lab assistant twice and it has not been repaired.

title: Smart board out of order
description: The smart board in lecture hall 2 does not switch on. It has been like this for three weeks and every lecture that needs it is getting affected.

title: Fans not working in classroom
description: Out of six fans in room 105 only two are running. In this heat it is hard to sit for four lectures. We complained ten days back.

title: AC not working in computer lab
description: The air conditioners in the computer lab have been off for over two weeks. The lab is suffocating with fifty systems running and the matter has been reported repeatedly.

title: Classroom is too hot, fans faulty
description: Three ceiling fans in the second year classroom are not working since last week and the regulators are broken. The electrician has not come despite reminders.

title: Many computers not working in lab
description: Nearly half the computers in lab 2 do not start. Two students have to share one system in every practical for the last three weeks.

title: Lab systems are very slow and keep hanging
description: The PCs in the programming lab hang every few minutes and the required software is not installed on many of them. This has been going on for a month.

title: Keyboards and mice broken in computer centre
description: A lot of systems in the computer centre have keyboards with missing keys and non working mice. We reported it two weeks ago and they are not replaced.

title: Campus wifi not working in academic block
description: The wifi in the academic block has been down for a week. We cannot open the LMS in class and the IT cell has given no update on our complaint.

title: No internet in the library
description: Internet in the library is not working for the past eight days, so e-journals and the online catalogue cannot be used. The librarian says IT has been informed.

title: College wifi keeps disconnecting
description: wifi in the dept building drops every few mins. we told IT so many times this month and it's still the same

title: Washrooms in academic block are dirty
description: The washrooms on the second floor of the main building have not been cleaned for days and there is no water in the taps. Complaints to housekeeping have not helped.

title: No water in department toilets
description: There has been no water supply in the toilets of the civil department for almost a week. Students have to walk to another building.

title: Girls washroom door latch broken and unclean
description: The girls washroom near the labs has broken latches on two doors and is cleaned very rarely. We have been raising this for the last two weeks.

title: Water cooler in department not working
description: The drinking water cooler on the first floor of our department is out of order for ten days. Students go to the canteen to buy water.

title: Drinking water not available in academic building
description: None of the water coolers in the academic building have had water since last week. It is summer and this was reported to the office twice.

title: Water filter in college not serviced
description: The water from the cooler near the library tastes bad and the filter has not been serviced for months. We complained two weeks ago.

title: Potholes on the road inside campus
description: The road from the main gate to the workshop is full of potholes. It has been in this condition for a month. When it rains the holes fill up with muddy water and it is slow and messy to ride or walk through. We reported it twice and no repair has started.

title: Water logging near entrance for weeks
description: Rain water collects near the entrance of the academic block and stays for days. We have to walk through dirty water. It was reported during the last rains as well.

title: Campus road in bad shape
description: The internal road near the playground is broken and muddy for several weeks now. Repeated requests to the maintenance section have brought no repair.

title: Street lights not working on campus road
description: The street lights between the library and the bus stop have not been working for two weeks. It is completely dark there after 6.30 pm.

title: Lights not working in corridor
description: Corridor lights on the third floor of the main block are fused for many days. Evening batch students walk in darkness. Complaint was given last week.

title: Parking area has no lighting
description: All the lamps in the student parking area are off since ten days. It is difficult to find vehicles in the evening and this has been reported twice.

title: Lift not working in academic block for a month
description: The lift in the five storey academic block has been shut for a month. Students with leg injuries and a classmate on crutches have to climb to the fourth floor.

title: Elevator out of service
description: The only elevator in the new building is out of service for three weeks. A differently abled student in our class is missing lectures held on upper floors.

title: Lift under repair for too long
description: Under maintenance board on the lift for 20 plus days, no work going on.

title: Broken benches in classroom
description: Several benches in room 210 are broken and nails are sticking out. Four students sit on a bench meant for three. This was reported at the start of the semester.

title: Desks damaged and not replaced
description: At least ten desks in our classroom have no writing board. Students write on their laps during tests. The department has been told many times in the past month.

title: Shortage of chairs in tutorial room
description: The tutorial room has thirty chairs for a batch of forty five. Every week some students stand through the class. The request for chairs is pending for weeks.

title: Roof leaking in classroom during rain
description: Water drips from the roof of room 402 whenever it rains and the back benches become unusable. This has been the case for the whole monsoon and no repair has been done.

title: Seepage in library wall damaging books
description: There is heavy seepage on one wall of the library and books on that shelf are getting damp. The librarian reported it weeks ago.

title: Leaking ceiling in drawing hall
description: The ceiling of the drawing hall leaks at three places. Drawing sheets get spoiled and we keep buckets under the leaks. It is pending since last month.

title: Lab equipment not working
description: Most of the oscilloscopes and function generators in the electronics lab are faulty. For three weeks we have been only watching the demo instead of doing experiments.

title: Faulty instruments in physics lab
description: In the physics lab the vernier calipers and spectrometers are damaged, readings come wrong. We told the lab in-charge repeatedly and nothing is replaced.

title: Machines in workshop out of order
description: Two of the three lathe machines in the workshop have been out of order for over a month. The whole batch waits for one machine during practicals.

title: Exposed live wires in electrical lab
description: There are open live wires near the workbench in the electrical lab and a student got a shock today during the practical. The lab should not be used till it is fixed.

title: Shock from computer cabinet in lab
description: A student received an electric shock from the metal body of a computer in lab 3 this afternoon. The earthing seems faulty and it is dangerous for everyone.

title: Open switch board sparking in classroom
description: The switch board in room 108 is hanging out of the wall with bare wires and it sparked today when the fan was switched on. Someone can get electrocuted.

title: Ceiling fan fell down in classroom
description: A ceiling fan fell in room 203 during the lecture today. It landed on an empty bench and missed a student by inches. The hook in the roof has rusted through, and the other fans in the room are shaking badly as well. Classes are still being held in that room.

title: Plaster fell from classroom roof and hurt a student
description: A large chunk of plaster fell from the roof in our classroom this morning and a girl was injured on the head. The roof has many more loose patches.

title: False ceiling collapsed in seminar hall
description: Part of the false ceiling in the seminar hall came down today during a session. Two students have minor injuries. The hall is unsafe to use.

title: Gas leak in chemistry lab
description: Gas smell in chemistry lab since morning, one burner pipe leaking. Practicals still going on.

title: LPG smell from lab gas line
description: We noticed gas leaking from the pipeline joint in the chemistry lab today. A student felt dizzy. The cylinder room has to be checked immediately.

title: Chemical fumes in laboratory, students unwell
description: The exhaust in the chemistry lab is not working and acid fumes filled the room today. Three students had breathing trouble and one fainted.

title: Short circuit and smoke in computer lab
description: Smoke came out of the UPS room next to the computer lab today and there was a burning smell. No fire extinguisher was found in the lab.

title: Fire in the canteen kitchen
description: A fire broke out in the canteen kitchen this afternoon. Staff controlled it with water. There are no extinguishers and the gas cylinders are kept right there.

title: Fire extinguishers expired and emergency exit locked
description: The fire extinguishers in the mechanical workshop expired last year and the emergency exit is kept locked. There was a small fire near the welding area today.

title: Open manhole on campus road, student fell in
description: A manhole on the road near the workshop has no cover. A student on a cycle fell into it last night and fractured his hand. It is still open.

title: Uncovered pit near parking is dangerous
description: A deep pit dug for cable work near the parking has been left without any barricade. A girl slipped into it today evening and is injured.

title: Drain cover missing, accident happened today
description: the drain in front of the library has no cover and one guy fell in today and twisted his ankle badly. pls cover it before someone gets seriously hurt

title: Tree about to fall on the main pathway
description: A big tree near the main pathway was uprooted halfway in yesterday's storm and is leaning over the walkway. It can fall on students any moment.

title: Boundary wall collapsed near playground
description: A portion of the boundary wall beside the playground collapsed this morning. Students were playing close by. The remaining wall is cracked and leaning.

title: Heavy branch fell on parked vehicles
description: A heavy branch broke and fell on the bike parking today, damaging vehicles. A student escaped narrowly. More dead branches are hanging above the parking.

title: Students stuck in lift for forty minutes
description: Five students were trapped in the academic block lift for forty minutes today. The alarm did not work and nobody had the key. One girl had a panic attack.

title: Lift dropped suddenly between floors
description: The lift in the main building dropped from the third to the second floor with a jerk this morning with students inside. It is still being used and is dangerous.

title: Lift door closing on people
description: The lift door sensor in the new block is not working and the door shut on a student's arm today, causing injury. It should be stopped immediately.

title: Staircase railing broken, student fell
description: The railing of the staircase in block 2 broke off today when a student held it and he fell several steps. He has been taken to hospital.

title: Window glass fell from third floor
description: A glass pane came off a third floor window and shattered on the walkway below today. Splinters hit one student. Other panes are loose too.

title: Broken tiles on stairs caused injury
description: Tiles on the main staircase are broken and sharp. A student slipped today and got a deep cut on the knee which needed stitches. Please repair at once.

title: College bus brakes failed today
description: The brakes of college bus number 7 failed on the way to campus today and the driver stopped it by hitting the divider. The bus is in a dangerous condition and was sent out again.

title: College bus is not roadworthy
description: The floor of the route 3 bus has a hole and the rear door does not close. Today a student almost fell out on a turn. This is a serious safety risk.

title: Bus tyre burst with students inside
description: The tyre of a college bus burst this morning with forty students on board. The tyres are completely worn out and the transport office ignores it.

title: Query about fee structure break-up
description: I would like to know the head-wise break-up of the annual fee, like tuition, development and exam fee. The receipt shows only a single amount.

title: Details of fee components
description: Can the accounts section share how much of the total fee is tuition fee and how much is for other charges? I need it for my own records.

title: Fee break-up required for information
description: General enquiry: where can I see the approved fee structure for my batch? The website has the structure of an older year.

title: Can fees be paid in instalments
description: My father is a farmer and gets income after harvest. Is there any option to pay the yearly fee in two instalments? Kindly guide.

title: Query on instalment facility for tuition fee
description: I want to ask whether the college allows part payment of the semester fee and what the process is to request it.

title: Enquiry about paying fee in parts
description: can hostel and tuition fee be paid in instalments? whom to meet in accounts for this

title: Query about scholarship eligibility
description: I scored 9.1 CGPA last year. Am I eligible for the merit scholarship and when do the applications start?

title: Information on scholarships for OBC students
description: Please tell me which government scholarships I can apply for through the college and what income certificate is required.

title: Which scholarships are available
description: I am a first year student and do not know about the scholarship schemes offered. Is there a list or a help desk for this?

title: Request for duplicate fee receipt
description: Lost my third semester fee receipt. How do I get a duplicate?

title: Need copy of old fee receipts
description: For income tax purposes my parents need copies of fee receipts of last year. Kindly let me know the procedure to get them.

title: Fee receipt download option
description: It would be convenient if earlier fee receipts could be downloaded from the student login. Right now only the latest one is visible.

title: Suggestion to add UPI option for fee payment
description: The fee portal accepts only net banking and cards. Please add UPI as a payment mode, it is easier for most parents.

title: Online payment modes are limited
description: This is a suggestion for the accounts department. Payment by UPI or wallet is not available on the fee page, including it would reduce the rush at the cash counter.

title: Request for QR code payment at fee counter
description: The fee counter takes only demand drafts and cash for small payments like certificate charges. A QR code for payment may be kept there.

title: Documents needed from college for education loan
description: I am applying for an education loan. Which documents does the college issue for the bank and how many days does it normally take?

title: Query regarding bank loan letter
description: My bank wants a fee estimate letter for all four years for the loan. Please tell me where to apply for this letter.

title: Education loan guidance
description: Does the college have a tie-up with any bank for student loans? I need some guidance before the next academic year.

title: Query on caution deposit refund process
description: I am in final year. I want to understand how and when the caution deposit is returned after the course is over.

title: When is security deposit returned
description: Could the accounts office clarify the procedure for getting back the library and lab security deposit at the time of leaving college?

title: Information about refundable deposit
description: At admission we paid a refundable deposit. Is any form to be filled in the last semester to claim it? Asking in advance.

title: Library late fine is high, suggestion to reduce
description: The library charges ten rupees per day for late return of a book. I suggest reducing it or giving a grace period of two days.

title: Request to waive small library fine during exams
description: During the exam weeks students forget to renew books. The fine for those days could be waived as a goodwill measure.

title: Suggestion regarding fine for late book return
description: The fine amount for overdue library books was doubled this year. Kindly reconsider it, since many students cannot afford it.

title: Query about backlog exam fee
description: How much is the exam fee for one backlog subject and can it be paid online? The notice does not mention the amount.

title: Fee for revaluation and photocopy
description: Please inform me of the charges for revaluation per paper and for the answer sheet photocopy, and where the payment is to be made.

title: What is the charge for a duplicate ID card
description: Lost my ID card. What is the duplicate fee and where to pay?

title: Query about fee concession for siblings
description: My younger sister is joining the same college this year. Is there any sibling concession in the tuition fee?

title: Is there a fee waiver for toppers
description: I topped my branch in the last university exam. Does the college give any fee waiver or prize money for that? Just want to know.

title: Enquiry on concession for single girl child
description: I read somewhere about a concession for a single girl child. Does our institute have such a scheme and how to apply?

title: Scholarship amount not credited
description: My state scholarship was sanctioned four months ago and the college received the amount as per the portal. It has still not been credited to my account.

title: Post matric scholarship pending since last year
description: The scholarship for the previous academic year has not come till now. The scholarship clerk says the bill is with accounts, and this answer is the same for three months.

title: Merit scholarship money not received
description: Merit scholarship awarded six months ago, amount not transferred despite two applications.

title: Fee paid online but not showing on portal
description: I paid the semester fee of 62,000 through net banking ten days ago. The amount was debited from my father's account the same minute and we have the bank statement. The portal still shows the fee as due, and now it has started adding a late fine. I have gone to the accounts office twice with the statement.

title: Payment successful but dues still shown
description: The tuition fee was paid by card on the 3rd and I have the bank message. Two weeks later the ERP shows the full amount as outstanding.

title: Fee payment not updated in accounts
description: My hostel fee payment made through the payment gateway is not updated for the last twelve days. I have mailed the transaction ID to accounts twice.

title: Fee deducted twice, refund pending
description: While paying the exam fee the amount got deducted twice from my account. I applied for a refund of the extra payment three weeks ago and have not got it.

title: Double payment of semester fee
description: Due to a gateway error 45,000 was debited two times. The accounts office accepted that one payment is extra but the refund is pending for over a month.

title: Excess amount paid, not refunded
description: I paid the bus fee twice by mistake, once online and once by cash. The refund request has been lying with the accounts section for many weeks.

title: Caution deposit not refunded after passing out
description: I passed out last year and submitted the no dues form. The caution deposit of 10,000 has not been refunded even after eight months.

title: Security deposit refund pending
description: course ended in may, all clearances done, still no deposit refund for months.. mailed accounts so many times, no reply at all

title: Refund of deposit delayed
description: It has been more than half a year since I applied for the refund of my library and lab deposit. Every time I call I am told the cheque is under process.

title: Hostel fee refund not received after vacating
description: I vacated the hostel in the first month of the semester and was promised a refund of the remaining hostel fee. Two months have gone and nothing has been credited.

title: Refund of hostel charges pending
description: I shifted out of the hostel in August with the warden's approval. The balance hostel fee refund is pending with accounts for ten weeks.

title: Hostel fees not returned though room was never allotted
description: I paid the hostel fee at admission but no room was given, so I stayed outside. My request for a full refund is pending for three months.

title: Mess rebate for leave days not given
description: I was on approved leave for 20 days and applied for mess rebate. The rebate amount has not been adjusted in the next bill or refunded, for two months now.

title: Mess fee refund for vacation pending
description: The mess was closed during the winter break but we were charged for the full month. The promised refund of mess fee has not been given for many weeks.

title: Mess bill charged for days I was at home
description: My mess bill includes fifteen days when I was at home on medical leave. I submitted the rebate form in time and the amount is still not returned after repeated visits.

title: Late fine charged though fee paid on time
description: I paid my fee two days before the last date and have the receipt. The portal has added a late fine of 2,000. My application to remove it is pending for two weeks.

title: Wrong penalty added to my fee account
description: A penalty for late payment has been put on my account although the delay was due to the bank server and I had informed accounts. It is not reversed after three reminders.

title: Fine imposed wrongly
description: The accounts department has charged me a late fee fine for the exam form, which I had submitted within the date. I complained ten days ago and it is still there.

title: Fee receipt not issued after payment
description: I paid the fee by demand draft at the counter two weeks ago. The official receipt has not been given and I need it for my loan.

title: No receipt for cash payment
description: Paid exam fee in cash fifteen days back, receipt still not given.

title: Receipt pending for hostel fee
description: The hostel fee receipt for this year has not been generated although the payment was made last month. I have asked at the counter many times.

title: Fee charged is more than in prospectus
description: The fee demanded this year is 8,000 more than what is written in the prospectus and the fee committee order. Accounts has not given an explanation for three weeks.

title: Extra charges added without notice
description: An amount under miscellaneous charges has been added to our semester fee without any circular. We asked for the details two weeks ago and got no reply.

title: Development fee collected twice in a year
description: Development fee has been taken in both semesters though it is an annual charge. The excess has not been adjusted despite a written request last month.

title: Bus fee charged though I do not use the bus
description: I am a hosteller and never opted for transport, still bus fee is added to my dues. I have been asking for its removal for the past month.

title: Transport fee refund pending
description: I stopped using the college bus in July and surrendered the pass. The refund of the remaining transport fee is pending for more than two months.

title: Transport charges wrongly added
description: My fee statement has transport charges for a route I am not on. The transport office and accounts keep sending me to each other for weeks.

title: Stipend not paid for three months
description: I am an M.Tech student with a teaching assistantship. The monthly stipend has not been paid for the last three months. I take the lab classes every week and sign the register, so there is nothing pending from my side. I am borrowing money from friends for rent and food.

title: Internship stipend from college pending
description: The stipend for the summer research internship in the department was to be paid in July. It is pending for many weeks and the office gives no date.

title: Fellowship amount delayed
description: My research fellowship has not been released since the start of the semester. I have submitted the attendance sheets every month and reminded the section twice.

title: Reimbursement for event expenses pending
description: I spent 6,500 from my pocket for the department tech fest with prior approval. The bills were submitted six weeks ago and the reimbursement has not come.

title: Travel allowance for competition not reimbursed
description: Our team represented the college in a national hackathon. The promised travel reimbursement is pending for two months after submitting tickets.

title: Project component bills not cleared
description: The bills of components purchased for the sponsored project were given to accounts last month. Payment has not been made and the shopkeeper is calling us repeatedly.

title: Fee demand letter for bank loan delayed
description: The bank requires a fee demand letter to release my loan instalment. I applied for it in the accounts office two weeks ago and it is not yet issued.

title: Loan disbursement held up by college paperwork
description: My education loan amount is stuck because the college has not confirmed the receipt of the earlier instalment to the bank. This is pending for three weeks.

title: Bank letter not provided by accounts section
description: I asked for a letter with the college bank details and fee amount for the loan cheque. It has been ten days and several visits, the letter is not signed.

title: Refund after admission cancellation not received
description: I cancelled my admission within the allowed period in August. The refund of fee as per rules has not been received even after three months.

title: Admission withdrawal refund pending
description: I withdrew from the course before classes began and submitted all original receipts. The college has not refunded the tuition fee for many months.

title: Fee not returned after branch change to another college
description: I got a seat in another college through the second round and cancelled here. The accounts office is delaying my refund for the last ten weeks.

title: Library fine for a book I returned
description: The library system shows a fine of 600 for a book that I returned on time. The fine is blocking my no dues and the matter is pending for two weeks.

title: Charged for a lost book that was returned
description: I have been asked to pay the cost of a book which I handed back at the counter last month. I complained to the librarian twice and the charge is not removed.

title: Wrong fine amount in library account
description: My library account shows overdue fine for 40 days though the book was renewed online. I raised it three weeks back and the amount keeps increasing.

title: Revaluation fee not refunded after marks increased
description: As per rules the revaluation fee is refunded if marks change. My marks increased by 12 and the refund is pending for two months.

title: Exam fee paid for subject later exempted
description: I paid the exam fee for a subject for which I was later given exemption. The refund application has been pending in the exam cell for six weeks.

title: Convocation fee collected but ceremony cancelled
description: We paid 1,500 as convocation fee and the ceremony did not take place. The amount has not been returned for several months despite requests.

title: Fee portal not working and last date is tomorrow
description: The last date to pay the semester fee is tomorrow and the payment page has been failing since morning. After tomorrow my name will be removed from the rolls.

title: Cannot pay fee before deadline today
description: Last day for fee is today. Gateway declines every transaction, counter says online only.

title: Payment failing, registration will be cancelled tomorrow
description: I have tried to pay the tuition fee six times and each time it fails after OTP. The notice says registration gets cancelled if fee is not paid by tomorrow noon.

title: Hall ticket blocked for fee dues that I already paid
description: My hall ticket is blocked showing fee dues of 18,000 which I paid last month, I have the receipt. The exam is tomorrow and accounts is not clearing it.

title: Not allowed in exam due to wrong dues
description: Accounts has put my name in the defaulter list by mistake and I am told I cannot write the exam starting tomorrow. My fee is fully paid.

title: Exam form rejected for pending fee, last date today
description: My exam form is rejected saying hostel fee is pending though it was paid in June. Today is the last date for the form and the accounts officer is on leave.

title: Clerk asking for bribe to process refund
description: A clerk in the accounts office told me that my refund file will move only if I pay him 2,000. This is a bribe and I have refused.

title: Money demanded for scholarship form signature
description: The staff member handling scholarships is asking each student for 500 rupees in cash to forward the form. This is corruption and many students have paid out of fear.

title: Bribe demanded for clearing no dues
description: I was openly asked for a bribe at the accounts counter to sign my no dues certificate today. He said otherwise the file will stay pending for months.

title: Scholarship form not forwarded, portal closes today
description: The government scholarship portal closes tonight and the college has not verified and forwarded my application submitted two weeks back. I will lose the whole year's scholarship.

title: Institute verification pending, scholarship deadline tomorrow
description: My scholarship application is stuck at institute level verification. The last date is tomorrow and the concerned clerk says he has no time.

title: College not approving scholarship renewal before last date
description: Renewal of my scholarship needs approval by the college login by tomorrow. I have visited the office daily this week. If it lapses I cannot pay my fees.

title: Name being struck off although loan cheque submitted
description: I got a notice that my name will be struck off tomorrow for non payment of fee. The bank loan cheque was handed to the accounts office last week and they have not deposited it.

title: Asked to leave class for unpaid fee today
description: Today I was sent out of the class for not paying fees, although my scholarship covers it and the amount is pending from the government side. I was told not to come from tomorrow.

title: Admission cancellation notice for fee already paid
description: I received a letter that my admission stands cancelled from tomorrow due to dues. I have paid everything and have all receipts. Please stop this immediately.

title: Fake receipt given for cash fee payment
description: I paid 30,000 in cash to a staff member at the fee counter and the receipt he gave turns out to be fake, the amount is not in the college account. This looks like corruption inside the office.

title: Staff collected money in personal account
description: An office assistant asked us to transfer the exam fee to his personal UPI number saying the portal was down. Now the college says no fee was received and our forms will be rejected tomorrow.

title: Cash taken without receipt by accounts staff
description: Hostel fee was taken from several students in cash by a person from accounts without any receipt, and it is not entered in the records. We suspect corruption and fear losing our money.

title: Loan sanction will lapse tomorrow without college letter
description: My education loan sanction expires tomorrow unless I submit the fee demand letter from college. Accounts has kept my application for ten days. I cannot continue studies without this loan.

title: Bank deadline today for bonafide and fee letter
description: The bank has given today as the final date to hand over the fee structure letter, otherwise the loan file is closed. The accounts section is not issuing it.

title: Loan instalment will be cancelled tomorrow
description: The bank will cancel my second loan instalment tomorrow as the college has not sent the utilisation certificate for the first one. I have requested accounts many times.

title: Suggestion for a gender sensitisation workshop
description: I suggest the college conduct a workshop on respectful behaviour and gender sensitivity for all first year students at the start of the session.

title: Request for awareness session on respectful conduct
description: It would be good if the women cell arranges a talk on how students should behave with each other and how to report misconduct. Just a suggestion.

title: Orientation on student code of conduct
description: Many freshers do not know what counts as misbehaviour towards classmates. A short orientation session every year would be a helpful step.

title: Query about how to contact the internal complaints committee
description: I want to know who the members of the internal complaints committee are and how a student can reach them. The notice board has an old list.

title: Is anonymous reporting of misconduct possible
description: General query: can a student report misbehaviour by someone without revealing their own name? Please share the procedure and the email of the committee.

title: Details of women cell and counsellor
description: Please put the women cell and counsellor contact details on the website.

title: Classmates mocking my accent repeatedly
description: A group in my class copies the way I speak English and laughs every time I answer in class. It has been going on for weeks and I have stopped speaking up.

title: Being made fun of for my language
description: Some batchmates keep teasing me for my pronunciation and for having studied in a Hindi medium school. It happens daily in the lab and it is affecting my confidence.

title: Constant teasing in class
description: A few students mimic how I talk every day. Told them to stop, they continue.

title: Teacher insults me in front of the class
description: One faculty member regularly makes sarcastic remarks about me in front of the whole class, calling me useless. This has happened in many lectures this month.

title: Humiliating comments by faculty during lecture
description: Whenever I ask a doubt, the teacher taunts me about my marks and says I do not deserve to be in this college. The whole class laughs. It has become a pattern.

title: Faculty singling me out with rude remarks
description: For the past several weeks one teacher has been picking on me in every lecture with insulting comments about my handwriting, my marks and my intelligence.

title: Rumours being spread about me
description: Some girls in my section are spreading false rumours about my character and have told others not to talk to me. I am being left out of everything for the last month.

title: Classmates have isolated me
description: A few students have turned the entire class against me by telling lies about me. Nobody sits with me or includes me in any group work. When I enter the room they go quiet and then laugh. It has continued for many weeks and I have started missing lectures because of it.

title: False stories circulated in my batch
description: False gossip about me and a senior is being passed around in my batch by two classmates. I confronted them twice, they deny it and keep doing it.

title: Body shaming by classmates
description: Three boys in my class call me names because of my weight and laugh when I walk in. This is repeated almost every day.

title: Comments on my appearance
description: I am regularly mocked for being thin and short by a group of students in the canteen. I have ignored it for weeks and it is not stopping.

title: Name calling over looks
description: Some classmates have given me an insulting nickname about my body and now half the class uses it. It hurts and I have asked them repeatedly to stop.

title: Lab assistant shouts at and insults students
description: The lab assistant in the workshop uses rude language and insults students for small mistakes. This has been his regular behaviour through the semester.

title: Rude behaviour of office staff
description: the clerk at the student section is so rude, throws our forms back and calls us idiots. happens again and again with everyone

title: Library staff humiliates students
description: A staff member in the library scolds students loudly in front of everyone for minor things and makes personal remarks. It has happened to me three times.

title: Trolled in class WhatsApp group
description: Memes are being made on me in the class WhatsApp group using my photo from a college event. This has been going on for two weeks and the admins do nothing.

title: Insulting stickers of my photo shared in group
description: Some students made stickers from my picture with mocking captions and they are shared daily in the batch group. I asked them to delete and they refused.

title: Jokes about me posted online by classmates
description: A classmate keeps posting jokes about me on the batch Instagram page. Everyone comments and laughs. I have reported the posts repeatedly.

title: Security guard humiliates students at gate
description: The guard at the main gate speaks in an insulting manner to students daily during ID checking and makes personal comments about girls' clothes.

title: Rude remarks by gate security on dress
description: Every morning the security person at the entrance comments on what girls are wearing and lectures us loudly in front of others. It has become routine.

title: Guard passes comments on students
description: One of the guards near the hostel gate stares and passes remarks whenever girls return in the evening. We have told the supervisor twice.

title: Teammates demean me in project group
description: My project teammates do not let me contribute, call me dumb in front of the guide and remove my name from the slides. This has gone on for the whole month.

title: Bullied by group members
description: In the mini project group two members constantly make fun of my coding skills and give me only errand work. I feel bullied every time we meet.

title: Sidelined and mocked in lab group
description: My lab partners laugh at every suggestion I make and have told the teacher I do no work, which is false. It has been happening repeatedly.

title: Ragging by seniors in hostel at night
description: Third year students come to our rooms after midnight and make first years stand for hours and sing. This ragging is happening every night this week.

title: Seniors ragging freshers
description: We are being ragged by seniors in the boys hostel. They call us to the terrace, take our phones and make us do humiliating acts. Ragging is banned, please stop it.

title: First year students troubled by seniors every night
description: A group of seniors wakes up juniors at 1 am, forces us to give introductions in a vulgar way and does not let us sleep. Everyone is terrified to complain about this ragging.

title: Physical ragging, junior slapped
description: Senior slapped me during ragging and forced 100 sit-ups. Legs swollen.

title: Beaten by seniors in the name of introduction
description: Yesterday night four seniors took me to their room for introduction and hit me with a belt when I refused to dance. This is physical assault and ragging.

title: Juniors forced to do sit-ups and kicked
description: Seniors made five of us kneel in the corridor for two hours and kicked one boy who fell. It is serious ragging and we are scared for our safety.

title: Seniors taking money from juniors by threat
description: Some final year boys are collecting 500 rupees from each fresher every week and threaten to beat us if we refuse. I have already paid three times.

title: Extortion by senior students
description: A senior forced me to recharge his phone and buy him food, saying he would make my hostel life hell otherwise. It is a clear threat and it is repeated daily.

title: Forced to pay for seniors' party
description: Juniors of our wing were made to pay for a party of the seniors. Those who said no were pushed around and threatened with being locked in the bathroom.

title: Inappropriate touching by a faculty member
description: A male faculty member touched me inappropriately on the shoulder and waist in the lab when I was alone finishing the experiment. I am scared to attend his practicals.

title: Sexual harassment by project guide
description: My project guide calls me to his cabin after college hours, makes comments on my body and held my hand yesterday. This is sexual harassment and I need protection.

title: Teacher misbehaved with me in cabin
description: A teacher asked me to come alone to discuss marks and tried to hug me. I ran out. I am in shock and scared to go to the department.

title: Boys passing vulgar comments near canteen
description: A gang of boys sits outside the canteen and passes vulgar comments and whistles at girls every day. Yesterday one of them blocked my way. This harassment must stop.

title: Eve teasing on the way to the hostel
description: Girls walking from the library to the hostel in the evening are followed by some students on bikes who shout obscene words. We are scared to use that road.

title: Obscene gestures by a group of students
description: Some senior boys make obscene gestures and sing dirty songs when girls of our class pass the parking area. It is sexual harassment and is happening daily.

title: Senior stalking me to hostel and class
description: A senior has been following me from class to the hostel gate for two weeks and waits outside my lab. I have told him to stop. This stalking is frightening me.

title: Being followed by a student everywhere
description: One boy from another branch follows me to the bus stop, the library and the canteen. He has somehow found my home address and told me so. I have changed my timings twice and he still turns up. I am scared and cannot move alone on campus.

title: Stalking and repeated calls from a classmate
description: A classmate calls me fifty times a day from different numbers, stands below my hostel window at night and tracks where I go. Please take action on this stalking.

title: Threat messages from classmate
description: After an argument in class, a classmate has been sending me messages that he will break my legs outside the campus. I have screenshots of every threat.

title: Threatened with violence by batchmate
description: A student from my batch came to my room with two friends and said they will beat me if I attend the placement test. I take this threat seriously.

title: Receiving threatening calls
description: I am getting calls from an unknown number saying I will be attacked if I do not withdraw my complaint against a senior. I am very scared and need urgent help.

title: Morphed photos of me being circulated
description: Someone has edited my photo in an obscene way and it is being forwarded in student groups. This is harassment and I am unable to face anyone in class.

title: Obscene messages sent to me by a student
description: A student of my department sends me vulgar messages and pictures on Instagram every night even after I blocked two of his accounts. It is sexual harassment.

title: Edited vulgar pictures of girls shared online
description: Photos of several girls from our class, including me, were taken from social media, morphed and posted on a page. We need urgent action to get it removed.

title: Caste based discrimination by faculty
description: A faculty member asks about my caste in class and says reserved category students do not deserve seats. He gives me lower marks in viva. This is caste discrimination.

title: Casteist remarks by classmates
description: Some classmates use casteist slurs for me and refuse to sit on the same bench or share lab equipment. I face this discrimination every single day.

title: Discriminated against because of my category
description: In the hostel mess a group of students makes me sit separately and insults me about my caste and scholarship. I am being discriminated against openly.

title: Assaulted by a group of students
description: Six students beat me up behind the workshop yesterday. Injuries on my face.

title: Physically attacked in hostel
description: Two hostel mates punched me and hit my head against the wall last night because I complained about their loud music. I had to get stitches and I am afraid to go back to my room.

title: Beaten by seniors outside the college gate
description: A few seniors caught me outside the gate today, slapped and kicked me for talking to a girl from their class. Please take action on this assault.

title: Guide demanding personal favours for signing thesis
description: My research guide says he will sign my thesis only if I go out for dinner with him and keeps messaging me late at night. This is harassment and misuse of position.

title: Faculty asking for favours in exchange for marks
description: A teacher hinted more than once that I will get good internal marks if I meet him privately outside college. I refused and now he is failing me. It is sexual harassment.

title: Supervisor harassing a research scholar
description: My supervisor makes me do his personal household work, calls at midnight, and threatens to cancel my registration if I say no. I am mentally exhausted.

title: Fake profile created with my photos
description: Somebody has made a fake Instagram profile in my name with my photos and is sending dirty messages to my classmates from it, as if I wrote them.

title: Fake account in my name sending abusive messages
description: Someone is pretending to be me on Facebook. The fake account uses my name and picture and posts abusive comments about teachers and girls of my class, and I am being blamed for them. I suspect a batchmate.

title: Impersonation on social media to defame me
description: My photos have been uploaded on a fake dating profile with my phone number, made to look like my own account. I am getting calls from strangers at night.

title: Insulted for my religion in hostel
description: My roommates make hateful comments about my religion and food, and have asked the warden to throw me out of the room. This is religious discrimination.

title: Discrimination against students from the north east
description: Students from the north east are called racist names in the mess and are not given rooms with others. We face this discrimination from seniors as well as staff.

title: Regional slurs and unfair treatment
description: I am from another state and a group in the hostel calls me an outsider, uses slurs and has damaged my belongings. The warden also discriminates when I complain.

title: Blackmailed with private photos
description: My ex-friend from the same class is blackmailing me, saying he will leak our private photos if I do not meet him. He sent a threat again today.

title: Threat to leak personal chats
description: A student has screenshots of my personal chats and demands money, otherwise he will send them to my parents and post them in groups. This threat is causing me panic.

title: Being blackmailed by a senior
description: A senior recorded a video of me at a party without my knowledge. Now he forces me to do his work and give him money, and threatens to make the video viral.

title: Warden using abusive language and hitting students
description: The hostel warden abuses students in filthy language and yesterday slapped a first year boy for coming five minutes late. This verbal and physical abuse happens often.

title: Physical punishment by hostel warden
description: Our warden hit two students with a stick last night during the room check and abused their parents in foul language. Everyone is afraid of him.

title: Caretaker misbehaves and threatens girls
description: The hostel caretaker enters girls' rooms without knocking, shouts at us abusively and said he would spoil our character certificate if we complain. It is harassment.

title: Friend talking about suicide due to bullying
description: My roommate has been bullied for months by a group in class and yesterday she said she wants to end her life. She has stopped eating. She may attempt suicide, please help now.

title: Having thoughts of self-harm because of constant humiliation
description: I am humiliated every day by my seniors in the lab and I have started having thoughts of self-harm. I do not know whom to talk to. I need help urgently.

title: Student in severe distress after harassment
description: A classmate who was targeted with nasty posts online has locked himself in his room and wrote a note about suicide. This is an emergency.

title: Molested in the college bus
description: A male student touched me deliberately in the crowded college bus this morning. I want strict action.

title: Inappropriate touching by bus conductor
description: The conductor of the college bus touches girls while giving tickets and did the same to me today. Several of us have faced this molestation.

title: Groped during college fest crowd
description: During the fest concert yesterday a boy from our college groped me in the crowd and his friends laughed. I can identify him. Please act on this molestation.

title: Gender discrimination by lab faculty
description: The workshop instructor does not let girls operate the machines and says engineering is not for women. He gives girls lower marks. This is gender discrimination.

title: Girls insulted and denied opportunities by teacher
description: A teacher openly says girls come to college only to get married and never selects a girl as team lead or for competitions. We are discriminated against in every activity.

title: Sexist remarks and bias in evaluation
description: Our faculty for the practical course comments on girls' clothes during viva and asks them easier questions mockingly. Such discrimination and harassment is humiliating.

title: Seniors threatening juniors not to complain
description: After we reported ragging, the same seniors came to our room and said they will make sure we do not survive four years here. They said it in front of ten students.

title: Pressure to withdraw anti-ragging complaint
description: I filed a complaint with the anti-ragging committee last week. Since then seniors corner me daily and threaten me to take it back, and my name was leaked to them.

title: Targeted after reporting ragging
description: Ever since I gave a written complaint about ragging, my room has been vandalised and the seniors threaten me every time they see me. I fear for my safety.

title: Mocked and pushed because of my disability
description: I use a crutch and some students imitate my walk, hide my crutch and yesterday pushed me on the stairs. This harassment of a disabled student must be stopped.

title: Visually impaired student tripped for fun
description: A few boys keep moving my things and tripping me for fun because I have low vision. Today I fell and got hurt. I am afraid to sit in my own class.

title: Student with stammer bullied and hit
description: Because I stammer, a group forces me to read aloud for their entertainment and one of them hit me on the head when I refused. It is abuse and I cannot take it any more.

title: Forced to join strike by student union members
description: Members of a student union entered our class, forced everyone out for their strike and threatened to beat those who stayed. Two students were shoved.

title: Intimidation by student group during protest
description: A political student group blocked the gate today and threatened day scholars who wanted to attend the exam. One boy was slapped. Students feel unsafe.

title: Threatened for not supporting a candidate in elections
description: Supporters of one panel in the student election came to my hostel room and said I will face consequences if I do not vote for them. It was an open threat.

title: Teacher hit a student in class
description: A faculty member slapped a student in front of the class today for not completing the journal and threw his bag out. This kind of physical abuse is unacceptable.

title: Humiliating punishment by faculty
description: A teacher made three students kneel outside the staff room for an hour and called them animals while others recorded videos. It is abuse of authority.

title: Faculty threw duster and injured me
description: The lecturer got angry at a wrong answer and threw the duster at my face. I have a cut near the eye. He also abused my parents.

title: Someone filming in the girls washroom
description: A phone was found hidden in the girls washroom of the academic block today with the camera recording. We are shocked and afraid to use any washroom now.

title: Peeping into girls hostel bathroom
description: A man was caught peeping through the ventilator of the girls hostel bathroom last night and ran away. It has happened before. This is serious harassment.

title: Boy recording video of girls in changing room
description: During sports day a student was seen recording girls in the changing room on his phone. He ran when we shouted. Urgent action is needed before the video spreads.
